headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, driven by AI‑related wins, but profit margins varied.
summary: Revenue rose across the board, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY surge and TCS's 15.4% increase. Operating margins stayed strong at TCS (24%) and Coforge (16%) but slipped for Infosys and Wipro. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by Wipro, reflecting mixed confidence. AI revenue grew sharply, especially for HCLTech and LTM.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue jumped 78% YoY for HCLTech and 47% for LTM, fueling deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins fell for Infosys and Wipro, while TCS and Coforge maintained or improved theirs.

themes.title: Guidance volatility
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; Wipro introduced a narrow Q3 outlook; other peers kept guidance unchanged.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
Largest revenue base with 15.4% YoY growth and 24% operating margin.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and a cut in FY27 guidance.
Revenue growth slowed to 9.1% YoY and net profit fell 1.9%.

domain_outlook.note: No explicit references to streaming services.
Gaming was not cited in any report.
Telecom sector impact was not discussed.
